institutes.notes: Located at the Technopole de Borj Cédria (Ben Arous). Departments listed on the site: Informatique et Mathématiques, Informatique Industrielle, Télécommunication, Technologies Éducatives. Official site istic.rnu.tn was unreachable from outside Tunisia during research (connection refused, Oct 2026); Wayback copies (latest 2025-06) show news only up to 'Planning examen session Mai 2024' and timetables categories per licence (LF Science de l'Informatique, LA Informatique Industrielle, LF Télécommunication, LA Réseaux et Télécommunication, LA Systèmes Automatiques, LA Systèmes Embarqués). Archived pages also contained injected pharmacy spam text, suggesting the CMS was compromised — treat the site as stale; recent announcements appear to go to Facebook (facebook.com/ucar.istic = 'ISTIC Borj-Cédria', ~11-14k followers; facebook.com/ISTIC.OFFICIEL = 'Modérateur Istic', posted 2025 graduation notice and 2024-2025 calendar; facebook.com/ISTIC.TN is the link in the website footer). Which FB page is the current official one is not confirmed. News list mentions 'Avis de Mutation, Réintégrations et Exclus Prepa 2022-2023', suggesting a preparatory cycle, unconfirmed. Website licence page names: LF Computer Science (GL & SI), Computer Engineering (Systèmes embarqués & IoT; Ingénierie des Réseaux et Systèmes), Automatique et informatique industrielle, Informatique réseaux et télécommunications. Orientini (2026 data): capacity 130 per licence; last orientation scores 164.68 (523), 155.83 (524), 135.65 (573), 131.26 (629); codes are orientini/guide codes, cross-check with orientation.tn. 2026-2027: licence registration online via inscription.tn from 7 Sept 2026, on-site 9-10 Sept (L1) and 11 Sept (L2/L3), rentrée 12 Sept 2026; master applications 10 June–10 July 2026 via UCAR master platform. Orientini hosts PDFs Avis_inscription_Licence_ISTIC_2026-2027.pdf and REGLEMENT_INTERIEUR_ISTIC_2026-2027.pdf. The ENT link (/ent) is from the archived menu; target not verified. No Moodle, public student Facebook/Telegram groups or exam archives found.

calendars.title: Calendrier de l'année universitaire 2026-2027 (Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur, national)
calendars.summary: Classes start 1 Sept 2026 for prep engineering institutes, engineering schools, ENAU, medical faculties, ENMV and ISETs; 12 Sept 2026 for all other institutions. Min. 28 weeks of classes. Holidays: Evacuation Day 15 Oct 2026; Revolution Day 17 Dec 2026; winter break 12-27 Dec 2026; 1 Jan 2027; spring break 19 Mar-4 Apr 2027; Independence Day 20 Mar; Martyrs' Day 9 Apr; Labour Day 1 May 2027; Mawlid, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha, Hijri New Year dates set later. Exam dates not given (attached circular PDF not checked). No UCAR-specific 2026-2027 calendar found.

calendars.title: ISTIC Borj Cédria – inscription et rentrée 2026-2027
calendars.summary: Online registration on inscription.tn from 7 Sept 2026; L1 on-site 9-10 Sept, L2/L3 11 Sept; rentrée 12 Sept 2026.

gaps: No UCAR-level academic calendar 2026-2027 found on ucar.rnu.tn; only the national ministry calendar (via orientini/press).

UCAR site states 35 institutions but publishes no complete list; list here built from Wikipedia, UCAR program pages and UCAR logos (36 entries incl. 3 research institutes). Possible missing/renamed entries (e.g. ISCC Bizerte vs ISG Bizerte) unverified.
Most *.rnu.tn institute sites were unreachable from outside Tunisia; websites/Facebook were taken from Wayback Machine snapshots and may be outdated.
No official websites/Facebook found for ISG Bizerte, IPEIN, ESA Mateur, ESA Mograne, ISPA Bizerte, ISEP-BG, ISTEUB, ENIB (Facebook).

Engineering/prep programs for INSAT, IPEST, IPEIB, IPEIN, ISEP-BG, INAT, ESIAT not fully listed; UCAR program pages cover licences/masters only and omit some institutes (e.g. ESSAI, EPT licences, ESAC licences).
Arabic names missing for several institutes where no source gave them.

ISTIC: no Moodle/e-learning, no public student Facebook groups or Telegram channels, no exam archives found; which Facebook page is the current official one is unconfirmed; official site appears stale since 2024.
No public old-exam archives found for any UCAR institute.
No sourced equipment lists (ENAU architecture, ISBAN fine arts) found.
Orientation codes only gathered for ISTIC (orientini) and ENAU; should be cross-checked with the official guide on orientation.tn.
